Sections.Label: Disposition
Entries: Hostile to each warband unless Aligned; Neutral to warbands Aligned with them.
Attacked or targeted by a Spell: becomes Hostile to that warband, which becomes Unaligned. Not if an opponent hired it against you.

Sections.Label: Aligning with a Neutral Hero
Entries: Cast Phase, once per turn: a unit within 5" makes a Morale Check. On a success you are Aligned, and it and its allies become Neutral to you.
Only if no warband is Aligned with it, you aren't Aligned with its opposing Hero, and you haven't been Aligned with it this game.

Entries.text: Hero rules take precedence over these.
steps: Upkeep: Recover. Pick up Treasure only if stated. Morale Check for Ongoing Spells. Target: closest Hostile unit by distance reachable without Agility Checks, else the one needing fewest.
Engage: Engage the Target if able, unless Retreating. No Out-of-Sight Roll.
Move: Not Engaged, Move straight at the Target, avoiding Agility Checks unless they are the only way.
Cast: Use its Spells and Abilities on the Target, else the closest Hostile unit in Line-of-Sight and range
Ranged: Not Engaged, shoot the Target, else the closest Hostile unit in Line-of-Sight and range.
Melee: Resolve the combat. Takes the Treasure of a unit it defeats.

Sections.Label: Other
Entries: Retreating: Moves to the closest board edge. Removed on reaching it.
Triggering Unit: Picked up the Treasure that triggered the Event.
Intercepts Engages made against other Neutral Units.
